title: Excellent ductilization and strengthening of lightweight refractory high-entropy alloys via stable B2 nanoprecipitates
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting of the corresponding pure metals (purity >99.9 wt%) in a Ti-doped high-purity argon atmosphere. The ingot was remelted at least 5 times to ensure the homogeneity of the element distribution. Then, the ingot was drop-cast into a water-cooled copper mold to obtain a cuboid-shaped specimen with dimensions of 10 mm × 10 mm × 60 mm.
